modules.description: Program governance, partner coordination, phasing, and adoption.

reasoning: Decomposition isolates patient-facing experiences, core scheduling, and payments from complex interoperability and offline home-care needs, while treating security/GDPR as a cross-cutting concern. Teleconsultation is a dedicated module due to real-time/WebRTC infrastructure and compliance. Reporting merges admin dashboards and regulatory outputs over a shared analytics data layer. Data migration is split out to manage CitaSalud cutover risk. Notifications and DevOps are separate to support September MVP readiness and operational scale. Uncertainties around HIS/eRx/lab interfaces and legacy data quality keep confidence at medium; the structure enables a phased MVP (agenda + portal + video + payments + notifications) while integrations and reporting proceed in parallel.
